title: Per-key (HLC, author) clock and write-time role admission
description: Every replicated verse/fractal/petal row and node row carries a _fe_clock of the entry author's own per-key versions; winners are the maximum (hlc, author, canonical value) among versions whose author held the required role at the write's hlc (fe-policy closed grant windows, revoke frontier), replacing arrival-ordered merges and current-role re-judging. Closes QA-0156, QA-0165, QA-0166 and QA-0126. Flag-day wire bump; peers upgrade together.
round4_defaults: q1/q6: flag day, peers upgrade together (user decision 2026-11-13 20:55); no dual-format writing, no version negotiation
q2: revoke frontier = highest write clock the revoker has received from the author (user decision); a revoker with no received writes closes the window at 0
q3: residual forged-old-clock risk accepted and documented in spec.md and field_clock/AGENTS.md; no further mitigation
q4: grant history capped at MAX_GRANT_WINDOWS = 8 closed windows per statement key (fe-policy/src/role_grants.rs:89)
q5: every member's latest version per key kept; deleted versions kept with no GC; GC deferred to a later track
q7: node transform folded into the per-key clock as keys; max (HLC, author DID) is the winner; edit_seq register retired for clocked rows (not re-verified at HEAD)
steer 22:55: grant windows honoured only when re-derived from locally admitted history (R-CLOCK-1, SEC-INBOX 4 CONFIRMED-FIXED)
